title: Roadmap: On Air and Pause rows
description: Notion roadmap rows that are On Air or Paused, with SP score, CPFT, LTV/CAC and spend as the nightly sync wrote them.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, json_group_array(json_object('url', url, 'name', "Name", 'ad_name', "Ad Name", 'status', "Production Status", 'sp_status', "SP status", 'sp', "SP score", 'cpft', "CPFT", 'ltv_cac', "LTV/CAC", 'spend', "Spend to date", 'market', "Market", 'format', "Format", 'source', "Source", 'category', "Category", 'creator', "Creator", 'hook_tag', "Hook Tag", 'feature', "Feature", 'persona', "Persona", 'priority', "Priority", 'watch', "Watch flag", 'pause_reason', "Pause reason", 'hit', "Hit ad", 'ad_ids', "Meta ad ID(s)", 'launch', "date:Launch date:start", 'paused', "date:Paused date:start", 'prod_date', "date:Production Date:start", 'synced', "date:Last synced:start", 'created', substr("Created time", 1, 10), 'edited', substr("Last edited time", 1, 10), 'learnings', "Learnings", 'hook', "Hook", 'parent', "Parent creative", 'reference', "Reference")) AS rows_json FROM "collection://46a9a0c5-2240-4576-8574-ce81793d224b" WHERE "Production Status" IN ('On Air', 'Pause')
